svg.title: Fullmag object, interaction, ProblemIR, and four-lane execution architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end Fullmag pipeline from fm.study authoring and scene objects (object_id, name, type, geometry AST, ObjectRegion, SI Material, m_0) and ordered stages, through explicit physics modules (field terms K_field -> H_k, direct torques tau_direct, coupled auxiliary PDEs, inter-region couplings Gamma_ab), into ProblemIR (requested intent), the fail-closed planner (fullmag-plan), ExecutionPlanIR, four independently qualified execution lanes (FDM CPU, FDM GPU, FEM CPU, FEM GPU), and materialized Zarr/binary outputs.
svg.text: Target intent only; no implicit physics
Ms, A, α, Ku, Kc, D · parameter fields
LLG: heun, rk4, rk23, rk45, abm3
